information: ![Image description](http://i.imgur.com/yztC4Jt.png) È disponibile una convenzione per il pranzo. Maggiori informazioni nella [scheda Pranzo](https://www.worldcubeassociation.org/competitions/VieniaCubareinPuglia2026#71384-pranzo-lunch). **Nota: dovrai pagare altri 10€ in loco se non sei un socio di Cubing Italy.** Associarsi è gratis! Scopri come nella [scheda Registrazione](https://www.worldcubeassociation.org/competitions/VieniaCubareinPuglia2026#71381-registrazione-registration-faq). --- ![Image description](https://i.imgur.com/YSp2SyW.png) A lunch deal is available. More information in the [Lunch tab](https://www.worldcubeassociation.org/competitions/VieniaCubareinPuglia2026#71384-pranzo-lunch). **Note: you will have to pay 10€ extra at the venue if you are not a Cubing Italy member.** Membership is free! More info in the [Registration tab](https://www.worldcubeassociation.org/competitions/VieniaCubareinPuglia2026#71381-registrazione-registration-faq).
